items.claim: She relies heavily on throwing forward volume and heavy one-twos.
items.quote: She's got a lot of volume and a lot of those heavy onet twos. That's what she's going to throw.

items.claim: She will pressure forward and force Amanda Lamos to fight backing up.
items.quote: She's going to come forward and sling heavy on one twos. She's likely going to be the one coming forward in this matchup, keeping uh keeping Amanda backing up.

items.claim: Grappling represents her best path to victory in this matchup.
items.quote: Now, in the grappling, this is probably her best path to victory.

items.claim: Grappling is how previous opponents have been able to defeat Amanda Lamos.
items.quote: that's kind of how people have been able to beat uh Amanda Lamos in the past.

items.claim: She effectively executes body locks, elevations, and forceful mat returns in her grappling exchanges.
items.quote: she gets to the body block, elevates her opponent just slightly off the ground, takes the legs out from under them, and sets them down... she'll set them on the mat hard follow them down
